vachanas.kannada:
ಆಯುಷ್ಯತೀರಲು ಮರಣ;
ವ್ರತ ತಪ್ಪಲು ಶರೀರ ಕಡೆ.
ಮೇಲುವ್ರತವೆಂಬ ತೂತರ ಮೆಚ್ಚ
ನಮ್ಮ ಅಗಜೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗವು.
vachanas.transliteration:
āyuṣyatīralu maraṇa;
vrata tappalu śarīra kaḍe.
mēluvratavemba tūtara mecca
nam'ma agajēśvaraliṅgavu.
vachanas.translation:
When the span of life comes to an end, there is death.
When one's vow is broken, the body meets its end.
Cherish the higher vow praised by the noble ones,
Says our Agajēśvaraliṅga.
